biography.plain_text: Diego Gómez González is a Spanish professional poker player known as El León. He finished fifth at the European Poker Tour's Prague main event in 2012, wearing a lion costume at the final table. He later won the Spanish Poker Championship's San Sebastián stop and competed at the World Series of Poker.

long_biography.plain_text:
Spanish poker player Diego Gómez González learned the game with relatives and school friends before taking it online. Study and practice led him into the national tournament circuit. He regarded poker as a source of enjoyment as well as income, valuing the freedom to travel and spend time with his family.

While living in Britain, he invested tournament winnings in a business alongside other poker players who also wanted to diversify. They chose luxury-vehicle rentals, examining both the car market and leisure boats. His investment drew on the prize from his Prague final-table appearance.
